sodium_plugin.page.title: View Shake Control
sodium_plugin.page.highlight.title: Highlight
sodium_plugin.page.hud.title: HUD Enhancements
sodium_plugin.option.shake_strength.tool: Controls the overall magnitude of first-person view bobbing. 0% disables it completely, 100% is the vanilla default.
sodium_plugin.option.sprint_shake.toolti: When disabled, sprint view bobbing is greatly reduced to a level close to walking (in 1.21.11 sprint bobbing comes from movement speed difference and cannot be fully zeroed).
sodium_plugin.option.damage_shake.toolti: When disabled, the screen will no longer tilt or shake when the player takes damage.
sodium_plugin.option.nausea_shake.toolti: When disabled, the nausea view distortion (e.g. from eating pufferfish) no longer appears.
sodium_plugin.option.potion_fov.tooltip: When disabled, potions like Speed or Slowness no longer change the field of view.
sodium_plugin.option.particle_percentage: Controls the percentage of particles spawned. 0% spawns none, 100% is vanilla.
sodium_plugin.option.fov_effect.tooltip: Field of view scale factor. 100% is vanilla, 50% zooms in, 300% is a 3x wide-angle view.
sodium_plugin.option.gamma_value.tooltip: Controls brightness. 100 is the vanilla default; higher values are brighter, up to 3000 (about 15x vanilla).
sodium_plugin.option.show_invisible_play: When enabled, invisible players (e.g. from Invisibility potions) are rendered fully visible like normal players (rendering only; game logic is unaffected).
sodium_plugin.option.potion_time.tooltip: Shows the remaining duration (in seconds) next to each active status effect icon on the HUD.
sodium_plugin.option.damage_display.tool: Shows the damage you deal above the health and hunger bars: the target, the amount, and the source (weapon or type).
sodium_plugin.option.explosion_credit.to: When enabled, explosion damage from end crystals, respawn anchors, TNT, etc. is also shown as damage you dealt (source labeled "explosion"). The client cannot tell whether an explosion was triggered by a block you placed, so type-based attribution is used; disable to show only direct-attack damage.
sodium_plugin.option.damage_float.toolti: When you hit an entity, the damage dealt floats up from the upper-center of the screen (rises and fades out).
sodium_plugin.page.hitreplay.title: Hit Replay
When enabled, logs only damage from other players (PvP): weapon, damage type, distance, critical hit and kill attribution. Environmental and mob damage are not logged.
sodium_plugin.option.hit_replay_max.tool: Maximum number of hit records to keep; older records are discarded once the limit is reached.
sodium_plugin.option.hit_replay_view.too: Open the hit replay viewer to browse your damage history and death information.
sodium_plugin.option.highlight_players.t: Draws a glowing outline around nearby players so they are easier to spot in dark or cluttered terrain. Client-side only; other players cannot see it.
sodium_plugin.option.highlight_range.too: Players within this distance (in blocks) are highlighted. Players farther away are left untouched.
sodium_plugin.option.highlight_color.too: Color of the glowing outline. The player's name tag takes the same color while highlighted.
sodium_plugin.page.autoscreenshot.title: Auto Screenshot
sodium_plugin.option.auto_screenshot_ena: Automatically save a screenshot on kill or death to the screenshots folder.
sodium_plugin.option.auto_screenshot_kil: Capture a screenshot whenever you kill an entity.
sodium_plugin.option.auto_screenshot_dea: Capture a screenshot when you die.
sodium_plugin.page.danger.title: Auxiliary Features
sodium_plugin.option.danger_button.toolt: Clicking this will crash the game instantly. Stay away.
sodium_plugin.option.target_status_hud.t: Shows the aimed player's name, distance, health and armor near the crosshair.
